name: Memory MCP Server
what: Reference MCP server that gives an AI basic persistent memory: a local knowledge graph of entities, relations and observations that survives across chats.
who: People who want their assistant to remember preferences and facts across chats.

setup.text: Add the server (or run the mcp/memory Docker image). Optionally set MEMORY_FILE_PATH to choose where the memory .jsonl file is stored:
Add a system prompt or custom instructions telling the assistant when to save and recall memories. The README includes an example prompt.

prompts: Remember that my main project uses Next.js and Supabase.
What do you remember about my coding preferences?
Store that my teammate Sam owns the billing code.
